source_evidence: You may cancel your policy within a short period (usually 10 to 30 days) of receiving it without a penalty fee called a surrender charge.
answer: A free look period is a short window after you receive a variable life insurance policy when you may cancel it without a surrender charge. It usually lasts 10 to 30 days. If you cancel, you will typically receive a refund of your premiums, but the refund may be adjusted up or down based on how your investment options performed. Check your contract for the exact length of the period and instructions for returning it.
